periods.comment: Historic mining was carried out along the north-west-striking Mount Coolon Lode.
Mount Coolon deposit discovered by Luke Reynolds.
Decline excavated by RGC. Terminated due to excessive water and bad ground conditions. Finished 200m short of original target of 895m.
Completion of a feasibiltiy study by RGC to exploit the Mount Coolon Lode in an open-pit style mining method. Environmental Impact Assessment and lease application submitted.
ACM Gold Ltd acquired RGC Ltd's 51% share in the Mount Coolon Joint Venture with Saracen Minerals NL. ACM reviewed feasibility study for open cut mining.
Normandy Poseidon purchased ACM Gold Ltd's 51% interest in the Mount Coolon Joint Venture.
Ross Mining NL purchased Normandy Poseidon's 51% share of the Mount Coolon Joint Venture with Saracen Minerals NL.
Ross Mining NL purchased the remaining 49% of the Mount Coolon Joint Venture from Saracen Minerals NL.
Open cut mining commenced but was abandoned later that year due to pit-wall instability.

answers.quote: The Mount Coolon gold mine in Queensland shut down in 1996 because its high-grade ore bodies were exhausted and the remaining reserves were not economically viable at the prevailing low gold prices. The mine’s operating costs exceeded revenue, leading the owners to cease production.

history.answer: Mount Coolon, an abandoned gold mine in Queensland, produced a total of 7,070.68 kg of gold between 1914 and 2005. The mine operated in several periods, including 1913-1939, 1987-1988, and 1995-1996, before closing in 1996 for an unquoted reason. It was owned by Mt Coolon Gold Mines Pty Ltd.

survey.answer: Mount Coolon (Geological Survey of Queensland site 41615) is recorded as an abandoned mine on the Mount Coolon 1:100,000 sheet (2.7km se of mount coolon, 220km sse of townsville), at -21.4059, 147.3549, located to within 10 m. The survey classes its gold as medium, 5-50 t, and also records silver (very small). Within 5 km it records 1 other historical workings, 1 of them with gold. The record gives a size band, not production figures, and holds no owners or closure dates.
sources: Geological Survey of Queensland, MINOCC historical workings (CC BY 4.0, State of Queensland), site 41615: https://spatial-gis.information.qld.gov.au/arcgis/rest/services/GeoscientificInformation/MiningResources/MapServer/16/query?where=site_no%3D41615&outFields=%2A&f=json
survey.brief: Mount Coolon: abandoned mine, gold medium

structured_record.answer: Mount Coolon (GSQ site 41615, 2.7km se of mount coolon, 220km sse of townsville) is recorded by the Geological Survey of Queensland as abandoned mine, gold size band medium, 5 - 50 t. Reported production: 7,070.68 kg gold, about 227,328 oz troy (converted here; the survey records 7,070.68 kg) (1914 to 2005, Mount Coolon, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Total_Ores_Prod, SITE_NO 41615)); 757.372 kg silver (1914 to 2005, Mount Coolon, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Total_Ores_Prod, SITE_NO 41615)); 574,498.17 tonnes ore (1914 to 2005, Mount Coolon, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Total_Ores_Prod, SITE_NO 41615)). GSQ MINOCC 2017 also lists 6 dated Production rows (gold: 3,742.63 kg 1914 to 1934; 1,839.09 kg 1934 to 1939; 17.18 kg 1940 to 1942; 1,461.86 kg 1996; 9.92 kg 2004 to 2005); see production. Closure: 1996 (no reason quoted) [Mount Coolon, unknown, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (MineHist, SITE_NO 41615, row 15)]. Years worked per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (MineHist, SITE_NO 41615): 1913-1939, 1913-1913, 1987-1988, 1988-1988, 1989-1989, 1991-1991, 1993-1993, 1995-1995, 1996-1996. Ownership and tenure: Mt Coolon Gold Mines Pty Ltd per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Tenure, SITE_NO 41615). GSQ MINOCC 2017 lists 43 company reports for this site: CR 3596, CR 4078, CR 14682, CR 14809, CR 15476, CR 15568, CR 15893, CR 15969, .... Not found: closure reason: the indexed sources give a closure year but quote no reason.
